bibliographic.title: Tonight by Moonlight
bibliographic.author: Caroline Berg
bibliographic.description:
Tonight is the full moon.
You have been summoned by a group you can't refuse.
You brought just one thing with you.
Can you find a way to end the cycle, or will you have to come back again?

Tonight by Moonlight is a 500 word interactive fiction game made in Twine for the Neo-Twiny Jam 2026.

There are five different types of full moon, fifteen different items, five different descriptions of the event, three different ways you can transform, three different endings and more! Your choices affect the outcome.

The cover image is a fantasy sketch of the full moon with spooky trees I did for Inktober 2024, and have been waiting to find the right time to use.

The game was created over the course of 3 days in Twine. The code and story are fully my own.
No AI was used in the making of this game.
